name: layer3-subscriptioniq
description: Review service names and monthly subscription costs that you enter manually. See monthly and annual totals, mark services to keep, investigate or plan to cancel, and compare the annual cost of those decisions. Cancellation-help links open an external search for the selected service. No cancellation, purchase, account access, document upload or bank-statement analysis is performed. Keep passwords, account numbers, payment-card details and medical information out of entries. Manual edits last for the current widget session.

defaultPrompt: Review Video Service at $10 and Music Service at $20 per month.
Review Cloud Storage at $2.99 per month.

positive.expected_behavior: Open an empty list with zero monthly and annual totals and manual service/cost fields.

positive.prompt: Review Video Service at USD10 and Music Service at USD20 per month.
positive.expected_behavior: Display both services, USD30 monthly and USD360 annual total.

positive.prompt: Review Free Service at USD0 per month.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the service with USD0 monthly and annual cost.

positive.prompt: Review Video Service at USD10 per month, mark it cancelling, and show the cancelling filter.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the supplied service under cancelling with USD10 monthly and USD120 annual planned reduction. State no actual cancellation occurred.

positive.prompt: Review Cloud Storage at USD2.99 per month.
positive.expected_behavior: USD2.99 monthly and USD35.88 annual total.

negative.prompt: Analyze my bank statement to find recurring charges.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request, upload or parse statements. Ask for manual nonsensitive service names and monthly costs if planning is wanted.

negative.prompt: Log into my account, cancel the service and buy a replacement.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request credentials, perform cancellation or process a purchase. Explain manual planning and external help searches.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, sales or automatic cancellation.

publication.release_notes: Repair tool inputs, text results and interactive UI. Use the shared HTTPS host, the MCP Apps bridge, explicit tool annotations and app-specific privacy disclosures. Remove unsupported data and account-action claims.
